EgyptsBookOfMysteryPayoutAndRulesShared.BodyWildOnTheWayFeature1: During any spins, some symbols (excluding Wild symbol and Scatter symbol) in reels 2, 3, 4 and/or 5 that occupy 2 to 4 symbols' spaces may have a silver frame around itself.
EgyptsBookOfMysteryPayoutAndRulesShared.BodyWildOnTheWayFeature2: At every new round after the new symbols have cascaded down, any silver-framed symbol(s) that is involved in a win in the previous round will be transformed into a randomly selected symbol (other than Wild symbol and Scatter symbol) with a gold frame around itself.
EgyptsBookOfMysteryPayoutAndRulesShared.BodyWildOnTheWayFeature3: At every new round after the new symbols have cascaded down, any gold-framed symbol(s) that is involved in a win in the previous round will be transformed into 2 to 4 Wild symbols depending on the number of symbol spaces occupied by that gold-framed symbol.
EgyptsBookOfMysteryPayoutAndRulesShared.BodySymbolTransformationFeature: During any spins, a symbol (excluding Wild symbol and Scatter symbol) will be randomly selected to replace 3 or more symbols on the reels before wins are paid.
EgyptsBookOfMysteryPayoutAndRulesShared.BodyFreeSpinFeature1: 4 or more Scatter symbols appearing anywhere will trigger the Free Spins Feature.
EgyptsBookOfMysteryPayoutAndRulesShared.BodyFreeSpinFeature2: Players may choose to start the Free Spins Feature with: 15 free spins with a starting multiplier of x1, 10 free spins with a starting multiplier of x5, 5 free spins with a starting multiplier of x10 or a Mystery Choice.
EgyptsBookOfMysteryPayoutAndRulesShared.BodyFreeSpinFeature3: If the Mystery Choice is selected, the Mystery Choice may award any combination of free spins and starting multiplier.
EgyptsBookOfMysteryPayoutAndRulesShared.BodyFreeSpinFeature4: During any free spin, if there are one or more winning symbols on the reels, after wins are paid and the new symbols have cascaded down, the win multiplier will be increased by 1.
EgyptsBookOfMysteryPayoutAndRulesShared.BodyFreeSpinFeature5: 3 or 4 Scatter symbols appearing anywhere during the Free Spins Feature will award 5 or 10 more free spins respectively.
EgyptsBookOfMysteryPayoutAndRulesShared.GeneralRulesPayoutValue4: Some symbols (excluding Wild symbol and Scatter symbol) in reels 2, 3, 4 and/or 5 may occupy 2 to 4 symbols' spaces and each of these symbols will represent as a single symbol during payout calculations.
EgyptsBookOfMysteryPayoutAndRulesShared.GeneralRulesPayoutValue5: Wild symbol substitutes for all symbols except Scatter symbol.
EgyptsBookOfMysteryPayoutAndRulesShared.GeneralRulesPayoutValue6: Wild symbol appears on reels 2, 3, 4 and 5 only.
EgyptsBookOfMysteryPayoutAndRulesShared.GeneralRulesPayoutValue7: After the payout of every round is made, all winning symbols will explode allowing the symbols above them to cascade down for a new round.
EgyptsBookOfMysteryPayoutAndRulesShared.GeneralRulesPayoutValue8: Additional winning combination will be tallied in every round until no more winning combination can be tallied.

EgyptsBookOfMysteryRules.GeneralRules1: Egypt's Book of Mystery is a 6-reel, 5-row video slot (with an additional reel on top of reel 2, 3, 4 and 5) featuring Wilds-on-the-Way and free spins with increasing multipliers.

GeneralRules2.value: The game is played with 20 base bet for %{2025} ways - %{32400} ways, bet level of %{minBetMtp} to %{maxBetMtp} and bet size of %{minChip} to %{maxChip}.
GeneralRules2.comment: %{minBetMtp}, %{maxBetMtp}, %{minChip}, %{maxChip} will be minimum bet level, maximum max level, minimum bet size and maximum bet size in numeric form. %{2025} and %{32400} are numbers that needs to be formatted
GeneralRules2.example: The game is played with 20 base bet for 2,025 ways - 32,400 ways, bet level of 1 to 10 and bet size of 0.05 to 50.

EgyptsBookOfMysteryRules.GeneralRules3: Free Spins Feature is played at the same bet size and bet level as the spin that triggered the Free Spins Feature.
EgyptsBookOfMysteryRules.FreeSpinFeature1: If the Free Spins Feature is triggered by more than 4 Scatter symbols, each additional Scatter symbol will add 4 free spins to the 15 free spins selection; 2 free spins to the 10 free spins selection; and 1 free spin to the 5 free spins selection.
EgyptsBookOfMysteryRules.FreeSpinFeature2: Tap on any selection to begin the free spins with the stated number of free spins and starting multiplier.
EgyptsBookOfMysteryRules.FreeSpinFeature3: Scatter symbols appears on the top additional reel only.
